DELETE FROM EDS.BOB_AUDITLOG WHERE AS_OF_DATE = (SELECT TOP 1 CONVERT(DATE,LEFT(RIGHT(FILE_NAME, 12), 8)) FROM D360.STG_EDS_BOB_AUDITLOG);

INSERT INTO EDS.BOB_AUDITLOG
(
    AS_OF_DATE
    ,ACTION
    ,AMT
    ,AUDIT_DETAIL
    ,CORP_ID
    ,CURR_CD
    ,ID
    ,IS_FO
    ,LOCAL_REF_NO
    ,LOG_DT
    ,LOG_TYPE
    ,OVERRIDE_USER
    ,PARENT_AUDIT_ID
    ,REASON
    ,STATUS
    ,TERMINAL_ID
    ,TRAN_CD
    ,TRAN_DESC
    ,TRAN_GRP_ID
    ,USER_CD
    ,isActive
    ,isLatest
    ,BNK_CODE
    ,SOURCE_CODE
    ,FILE_NAME
    ,insert_dttm
)

SELECT 
CONVERT(DATE,LEFT(RIGHT(FILE_NAME, 12), 8)) AS AS_OF_DATE
    ,ACTION
    ,AMT
    ,AUDIT_DETAIL
    ,CORP_ID
    ,CURR_CD
    ,ID
    ,IS_FO
    ,LOCAL_REF_NO
    ,LOG_DT
    ,LOG_TYPE
    ,OVERRIDE_USER
    ,PARENT_AUDIT_ID
    ,REASON
    ,STATUS
    ,TERMINAL_ID
    ,TRAN_CD
    ,TRAN_DESC
    ,TRAN_GRP_ID
    ,USER_CD
    ,1 as isActive
    ,1 as isLatest
    ,left(FILE_NAME, 5) as BNK_CODE
    ,substring(FILE_NAME,7,3) as SOURCE_CODE
    ,FILE_NAME
    ,convert(datetime2,insert_dttm) as insert_dttm
FROM D360.STG_EDS_BOB_AUDITLOG
WHERE H = 'D'
